title: Bengaluru - BDA plan sanction (seed)
citation: Bangalore Development Authority building sanction, read with the BBMP Building Bye-laws 2020
verify: BDA sanctions plots in BDA-formed layouts; the corporation sanctions the rest. Confirm which authority owns this plot BEFORE choosing a template - the sets differ and a set sent to the wrong desk is returned unread. Every field below is a seed.
